title: Kasha with Mushrooms and Onions
summary: Egg-coated roasted buckwheat simmered in stock and folded with golden onions and mushrooms.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat the oil and butter in the frying pan and cook the onion and mushrooms over medium heat 10-12 min until golden; set aside.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Stir the groats with the egg white in the bowl until every grain is coated.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Tip into the dry saucepan over medium heat and stir 2-3 min until the grains separate and look dry, with no wet egg left.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the stock, thyme, salt and pepper, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat 10-15 min until the liquid is absorbed.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Off the heat, lay the towel under the lid and leave 10 min.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fluff with a fork, fold in the onions and mushrooms and scatter with parsley.

tips: Choose coarse or whole groats; fine kasha turns mushy.
Keep the heat very low while it simmers.
Use oil only for a dairy-free version.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
